input.prompt: Turn this layout guide into a photoreal flat orthographic top-down game texture of a military aircraft throttle quadrant gate plate. KEEP THE LAYOUT EXACTLY: same canvas, the black rectangular slot opening in exactly the same place and size (pure black inside, with a thin machined metal lip around its edge), the IDLE, MIL and MAX labels and their tick marks at exactly the same heights, the small tick marks along both sides of the slot, the FRICTION label and its round dial at the same place on the right (make the dial a recessed knurled ring), and the screws at the edges. Matte dark charcoal grey anodised aluminium with subtle wear and scratches, crisp white stencilled text. No perspective, no extra text, no extra objects, even flat lighting.
